messages:
maya: Quick sync: we plan to run a quant canary next week and need to shrink the promptbank first. aim is to preserve long-context and rare intents while cutting head redundancy.
linh: propose shrink rules: bucket by (intent, len_bin, source_anchor), then within-bucket dedupe by sim-embeddings + tokenized-normalized text. cap per-bucket to control cohort sizes.
raj: what final bank size are we targeting? current ~1.2M right?
maya: yes. target ~80k +/- 40k depending on coverage. also carve out a 2k golden holdout that stays frozen for regression checks.
ben: labeling for the golden: stage1 fast-pass (crowd labelers OK/FAIL), stage2 expert adjudication for conflicts. estimate ~3 FTE-weeks if we parallelize.
linh: sample script (will push to repo):
```
python tools/shrink_bank.py \ 
  --input s3://redwood/promptbank/v1.2/ \ 
  --group intent,len_bin,anchor_id \ 
  --sim_thresh 0.88 \ 
  --sparsity 0.10 \ 
  --cap 150 \ 
  --out s3://redwood/curation/shrunk/qcanary/ \ 
  --summary-csv s3://redwood/curation/shrunk/qcanary/summary.csv
```
linh: normalization pipeline: lowercase, unicode-nfd, strip-urls, normalize-quotes, collapse-whitespace; embed with lm-tokenizer-v2 before sim.
raj: please include sample-dropped per-cohort in summary so product can eyeball losses. we've seen rare-intent dropoffs before.
maya: timeline: Tue AM run shrink (linh), Tue PM review summary (ben+raj), Wed-Thu labeling golden, Fri run 8-bit canary.
aiops-bot: Created ticket INF-2222: "shrink promptbank for q-canary + golden holdout" assigned to @linh @ben. https://redwood.internal/infra/tickets/INF-2222
ben: ack. I'll provision the labeling queue and tag tasks `qcanary-golden`.
linh: ack. running a small smoke sample now and will post summary link in the ticket.
raj: ack. reserving canary infra and adding a 20% capacity buffer.
maya: thanks everyone. if the summary shows cohort collapse ping immediately and we'll adjust caps. :thumbsup:
